name: Himal Nepali Kitchen
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Himal Nepali Kitchen in Innsbruck!**

Discover the vibrant flavors of Nepal in the heart of the **Alpenland Tirol**. Our cozy restaurant invites you to experience authentic Nepali cuisine, from hearty **Dal Bhat** to aromatic **Momos** and fragrant **Thukpa**.

Indulge in traditional dishes like **Yomari**, **Chatamari**, and **Sel Roti**, all made with love and fresh, locally sourced ingredients. Don’t miss our famous **Kwati** – a refreshing drink that’s perfect for any time of day.

Whether you’re craving something spicy, sweet, or savory, our menu has it all. Pair your meal with a steaming cup of **Masala Chai** or a cold **Raksi** for the full Nepali experience.

**Himal Nepali Kitchen** – where every bite takes you on a journey to the Himalayas, right here in **Innsbruck**!
